gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; Glioblastoma Multiforme; Glioblastoma Multiforme of Brain; Glioblastoma Multiforme, Adult
Neuro-pharmacological Properties of Repurposed Ketoconazole in Glioblastomas
Evidence of primary or recurrent high-grade gliomas (HGG) that in the opinion of the treating team would require surgical resection

candidate_evidence.quote: This research is being done to find out if the study drug (ketoconazole) can enter brain tumors at a high enough amount to stop the tumor cells from dividing.
Participants will be taking 400 mg of the study drug (two 200 mg tablets) by mouth twice a day until the day of biopsy or surgery.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Evidence of primary or recurrent high-grade gliomas (HGG) that in the opinion of the treating team would require surgical resection

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Assessment of the concentration versus time curves of drug in the dialysate fluid
demonstration of adequate penetrance of study drug in brain and tumor tissue (pharmacokinetics)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Hexokinase activity assay- measured as a proportion of hexokinase enzyme activity in relation to positive control: Measured using a hexokinase assay on tumor tissue
Concentration of lactate measured using mass spectrometry in resected tumor tissue

role_evidence.quote: Ketoconazole (other names: Nizoral): 400 mg (two 200 mg tablets) orally
Ketoconazole is a drug which doctors already use for fungal infections and is thought to be able to effect tumor cells.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: inhibition of hexokinase 2 (HK2) activity and glycolysis

biomarkers.biomarker_other: hexokinase (HK2) activity / glycolytic metabolites (lactate, pyruvate) in tumour

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0) -> translational subset. Conditions/title name only glioblastoma, but inclusion admits primary or recurrent high-grade gliomas, so coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named (gbm_only also defensible; both include). Detailed description inconsistently says the trial will focus on posaconazole exclusively and mentions 5 control participants, while the registered arm, intervention and outcomes are ketoconazole only (single group); coded per registered intervention. Ki-67 and TUNEL tissue endpoints not recorded as molecular biomarkers.
